featured.title: Multi-select in tables
featured.description: Select transactions and recurring transactions together: delete several at once, or update description, category, payment method, recipient, and chomesh in one save. Fields you do not touch stay unchanged.

help.title: Guided tour and help button
help.description: Home, Add Transaction, and bulk import have a help button in the top corner. New users also get a short first-run tour.

halacha.title: Download the Halacha booklet
halacha.description: From the Halacha page you can download a designed booklet for reading or print.

reminders.title: Refreshed reminder emails
reminders.description: We improved the email design and added an Encouragement Corner. Enable reminders in Settings — otherwise you will not receive them.
